csv_project_name: A/E Service for Wake County Renovations Project
csv_scope_of_work: Architectural and engineering firms to provide design services for involving modification and renovation to County Buildings. The project types will vary in type and scale, ranging from work requiring informal bids (construction cost less than $500,000) to scope that dictates formal range bidding (construction cost exceeding $500,000). Example locations could include the Waverly F. Akins Wake County Office Building, Justice Center and Public Safety Center in addition to various Public Safety facilities, Human Services, Library system and Parks buildings, historic buildings and other County department sites. All facilities house a variety of functions and include administrative offices, meeting areas, conference rooms, utility and storage spaces, judicial and detention spaces, public areas and other related support functions that serve the community.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Utility Engineering

title: A/E Services for Wake County Renovation Projects
short_description: Design services for renovation and modification of various Wake County buildings.
project_location: Raleigh, Wake County, North Carolina, USA
project_scope: Indefinite renovation and modification projects for various Wake County buildings and sites. Project types vary in type and scale, with individual construction costs ranging from less than 500000 USD to more than 500000 USD, and an overall stated total construction cost range of 100000 USD to 8000000 USD. Example facilities include the Waverly F. Akins Wake County Office Building, Justice Center, Public Safety Center, public safety facilities, human services buildings, libraries, parks buildings, historic buildings, and other county department sites. Spaces include administrative offices, meeting and conference rooms, utility and storage spaces, judicial and detention spaces, public areas, and related support functions.
services: Architectural and engineering design services for renovation projects, including architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, and utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily renovation and refurbishment of existing county buildings, which is generally low priority for sbp.
- Focus is on general building and multidisciplinary A/E services rather than structural innovation or special load-bearing structures.
- Includes many administrative and routine public buildings, which are explicitly of limited interest.
- No indication of long spans, complex structural systems, bridges, roofs, stadiums, towers, or architecturally demanding special structures.
- Could include some civil engineering input, but the notice does not emphasize structural design complexity.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents. The notice states a total construction cost range of 100000 USD to 8000000 USD; the upper bound is used as the most relevant stated figure for the program.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the notice. The procurement appears to be for up to 2 to 4 contracts over a 72-month period, but no reliable fee estimate can be derived from the provided information alone.
references_qualifications: Architectural and engineering firms are sought for renovation and modification projects across multiple county facilities. Requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil, electrical, fire protection, mechanical, and utility engineering. No specific minimum number of references or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Wake County Purchasing Department, Raleigh, North Carolina, USA. Contact: Dave Delcambre. Phone: 919-856-6353. Fax: 919-856-6880. Email: david.delcambre@wake.gov. Website: https://www.wake.gov/departments-government/finance/current-business-opportunities
notes: Project number 26-065. Procurement stage: RFP/RFQ. Questions deadline: 2026-06-30 05:00 PM EDT. Up to 2 and 4 contracts may be awarded. Contract duration/base period: 72 months. This appears to be a multi-project on-call renovation services contract rather than a single defined building project.
